reader.requirement: At --std 85, when the OCCURS DEPENDING ON entry is subordinate to an entry with the GLOBAL clause (a GLOBAL 01 or a GLOBAL FD), data-name-1 must be a global name AND must be described in the same Data Division as the table.

edition-consulted.switches: DialectLevel < 2002: a report SUM counter may be data-name-1; its globality is then its report's (DependingAttributeFault via SumCounterReportOf)

reader.edition-search: grep Edition|DialectLevel|Construct in OdoResolvePass.cs#DependingAttributeFault and DataBinder.Odo.cs#IsGlobalRecord: neither reads the edition
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witnesses cover a global counter admitted and a non-global one refused; a GLOBAL FD's record and the 'described in the same Data Division' half are not exercised

probes.printed: error COBOL2788: ... the table's record 'G' is global and data-name-1 is not a global name
error COBOL2788 (table in a record of a GLOBAL FD, counter local)
EXIT 0, AB| (contained program references the container's global table; counter 2)
EXIT 0, AB| (inner GLOBAL table depends on the container's GLOBAL NG)
probes.expected: refused: data-name-1 is not described in the same Data Division

citations.check: OK  §1985:VI.5.8.3 SR9  (5.8.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR9
OK  §1985:X.4.6.4 GR2  (║4.6.4 General Rules║)  the text is in GR2

reader.notes: The global-name half holds for WS and FD records. The same-Data-Division half is not enforced: a contained program's GLOBAL table compiles and runs with DEPENDING ON its container's GLOBAL counter. This is the same omission as SR8, in the same member.
